stem:
【阅读理解·记叙类语篇】
My cousin Lily decided to enter the school storytelling contest. For weeks, she stayed up late, rewriting her fairy tale again and again. On the day of the contest, her hands were shaking so badly that she almost dropped her notebook. When she finally stepped onto the stage, she took a deep breath and began: "Once upon a time, in a forest far away, there lived a brave little fox..." Her voice grew steadier with each sentence, and the audience listened in silence. By the end, everyone stood up and clapped.
问题：Which of the following best describes how Lily changes during the story?
options: A. She goes from being nervous to feeling confident.
B. She changes from being happy to feeling sad.
C. She turns from being shy to becoming angry.
D. She moves from being careless to becoming careless again.

A clever crow was very thirsty. She saw a pot of water, but the water was too low for her to reach. She looked around and noticed many small stones. She picked them up one by one with her beak and dropped them into the pot. Slowly, the water rose until it was high enough for her to drink.
问题：What does the story mainly want to teach us?
options: A. Always drink water when thirsty.
B. Use your brain instead of giving up.
C. Stones are useless in daily life.
D. Birds should not drink from pots.
